items.synopsis: The rpd crash is seen when using a BGP neighbor telemetry subscription in a sharding environment
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, the rpd crash will be seen when the BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) neighbor telemetry subscription is used in the sharding environment leading to a layer-3 traffic drop.

items.synopsis: MX304: Bugatti: MX304 MACSEC over pseudowire issues
items.description: MACsec will work as long as the pseudowire is not performed on Bugatti, Alfa Romeo, Redbull, Ferrari since macsec control plane packets need to flow thru the pseudowire. If pseudo wire is done on a different router, then there is no issue with MACsec control plane flowing over the pseudo wire.

items.synopsis: FPC ungracefully restarts when cda-bt process crashes
items.description: On all Junos OS Evolved in a very rare scenario, when evo-cda-bt is killed, the agentd and other processes would crash due to an ungraceful FPC (Flexible PIC Concentrator) restart. This issue is not seen in a normal working scenario and is seen only upon ungraceful FPC restarts. The issue is seen when an important application is brought down and due to which FPC also goes down. Since FPC goes down there will be traffic loss.

items.synopsis: Show commands may not work after ISSU upgrade
items.description: After ISSU upgrade, CLI show commands may not work and needs cmdd restart on all the nodes.

items.synopsis: Interface physical ip address is assigned to SNMP Trap source address after chassis restart although source-address lo0 is configured under trap-options
items.description: Interface physical ip address is assigned to SNMP Trap source address after chassis restart although source-address lo0 is configured under trap-options

items.synopsis: The kernel crash would be observed in an EVPN multi-homed scenario
items.description: On QFX10002/QFX10008/QFX10016 (only QFX10K) platforms, when Assisted Replication (AR) feature as Replicator role is used in an Ethernet VPN (EVPN) multi-homed scenario, there would be out-of-bound memory access issue observed which could result in the kernel crash leading to the service impact.

items.category: Category for JET(JUNOS Extension Toolkit) related issues
items.synopsis: The connection might get closed by the collector when connecting to jsd
items.description: The collector connects to jsd and before acceptance can be called by gRPC, the connection might get closed by the collector.

items.synopsis: BGP or OSPF neighbors will not come up in Junos OS Evolved platforms if IPSEC Security Associations are used to Authenticate the peer
items.description: The issue is seen when there is interoperability between Junos OS Evolved and other vendors or Junos, BGP (Border Gateway Protocol)/OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) neighbors will not come up if IPSEC (IP Security) Security Associations are used to authenticate the peer.

items.synopsis: The LLDP output packets are not transmitting on the em0 interface of Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms
items.description: On Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, if a management Ethernet interface(em0) has an inet or inet6 family configured and "delete interfaces em0" is issued, the Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) output packets will stop transmitting, causing the LLDP neighborship to remain down in peer router.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: JDI-RCT:M/Mx: While removing VRRP configs and adding them back, mgd process stuck at 100% and router hangs forever.
items.description: While removing VRRP configs and adding them back, the mgd process stuck at 100% and the router hangs forever.

items.synopsis: ACX7K: Ping with static ARP on IRB unit doesn't work after reboot. Deactivate/activate arp config recovers.
items.description: ON ACX7K Static ARP on IRB IFLs (unit) stops working after reboot of chassis. Without static ARP it will work.

items.category: JDHCP is a daemon for EVO platform to handle DHCP protocol
items.synopsis: ACX7100-48L : jdhcpd core seen on boot
items.description: core is seen when any invalid range of interfaces in committed in any group under dhcpv6 dhcp-local-server system services and the box is booted. For eg :- set system services dhcp-local-server group g1 interface ge-0/0/1.3 upto ge-0/0/1.1
